DISCUSSION

Enhancement
of
mMDH
stability
in
progressively
higher
protein
concentrations
is

consistent
with
developed
models
of
molecular
crowding
( Garner
&
Burg ,
1994 ) .
High

concentrations
of
BSA
favor
more
compact
protein
structures ,
which
may
be
less
prone
to

denaturation .

study
suggests
that
these
effects
